observations: A solid black lobed form sits center-left against a flat yellow-green field; short zigzag lines radiate outward from it in all directions at varying lengths.
Two orange spiral eyes and a jagged orange mouth mark the front of the black form; the orange lines are thin and looping against the dark mass.
A thick black vertical stem drops from the form toward a flat black ground strip; a smaller leaf-like silhouette branches right from the stem near the bottom.
reading: The black lobed mass reads as both flower head and face at once, its orange spiral eyes giving it a wide-awake, unsettled look. The radiating zigzag lines suggest agitation rather than warmth. Against the flat acid-green field, the figure feels exposed and slightly absurd — a form caught mid-alarm, neither fully plant nor fully character.
